criteria.frozenAuthority: spike.md AC01; "§1 Complete Skill ↔ Contract Fidelity Audit"
criteria.sufficiency: M-A directly reviews design-map.md's already-frozen, implementation-immutable fidelity matrix (all 8 roles x all listed dimensions, each with exactly one disposition), reviewed at preparation time and re-confirmed at verify time only by the content-identity match the evaluator skill's own 'Establish immutable inputs' step already requires.

E1 statically checks the contract-level dimensions of the fidelity matrix (git capabilities, workspaces, forbiddenExposure, methodology enums) against the final committed contracts; M-A confirms the frozen matrix itself leaves no unresolved finding (every row carries MATCH/SKILL_MUST_CHANGE/CONTRACT_MUST_CHANGE/KERNEL_SUPPORT_REQUIRED/INTENTIONALLY_ARTIFACT_ONLY).

E1 reads all 8 committed role contracts and asserts each grants git-inspect and git-commit; the JSON contract schema is a pre-existing, already-public repository format, not a 014b invention, so this is fairly checked without waiting for implementation to choose a representation.

E1 checks no contract grants git-publish/network capability or an out-of-bounds workspace; E3 checks no active role skill's prose contains "push" or claims git-publish; M-B manually confirms no skill instructs itself to record its own canonical transition (a grammatical-subject judgment a pattern match cannot fairly make).

M-B reviews each migrated skill's completion/postcondition section for an explicit instruction to report the exact produced local commit; the exact phrasing is not fixed by frozen authority, so this is a reading-comprehension judgment, not a stable hidden-test seam.

M-B confirms brief-readiness/SKILL.md explicitly states that "Ready after minor clarification" maps to machine verdict READY as a non-blocking finding; a hidden regex would be fragile against equally-compliant rephrasing of the frozen Design Map's target sentence, so this stays manual.

E2 reads the committed evaluator-verify.json and asserts methodology.classification is exactly the five frozen values with no SPECIFICATION_DEFECT anywhere under methodologies/; this is a deterministic, implementation-independent check of an already-public contract field.

The frozen Design Map classifies cross-field enforcement itself as KERNEL_SUPPORT_REQUIRED (out of 014b's implementation scope); AC08 only requires the invariant be documented, which M-B confirms by reading the evaluator skill/contract for an explicit PASS-no-classification / non-PASS-exactly-one-classification statement.

M-B confirms evaluator-repair.json's inputs (or the skill's repair-mode prose) bind an exact authoritative trigger rather than leaving repair eligibility discoverable from mutable repository state; the exact field name/shape is not fixed by frozen authority, so this is judged by reading the final artifact, not a pre-authored hidden test.
E1 asserts as-built.json's methodology object stays empty, i.e. Missing/Contradictory/Extra remain artifact findings and are never promoted into a singular workflow result.

E4 reads outcome.json and asserts its methodology object exposes some field with both a STANDARD-shaped and a PROCESS_EXCEPTION-shaped value, and never combines PASS-shaped with PROCESS_EXCEPTION-shaped values in the same enum; tolerant of the exact field name, which frozen brief §4 explicitly leaves free.

C-C requires the implementation's own visible npm test suite to demonstrate one deterministic, stable methodology identity binding policy/contracts/skills/validators, corroborated by manual inspection of the implementation-identified entry point; the mechanism's storage/representation is explicit Design Map implementation freedom, so no pre-implementation hidden-test seam is justified beyond that obligation.

C-C's manual-inspection component confirms editing any skill (including evaluator) produces a candidate identity that cannot alter the identity already bound to a running workflow grant, reviewed against the implementation-identified mechanism rather than a pre-authored hidden test that would have to invent its shape.

C-C's manual-inspection component confirms the frozen bootstrap-pinned evaluator (this very preparation's own authority, per bootstrap/authority.md) governs Spike 014b's own evaluation, and that no code path in the implemented mechanism lets a candidate evaluator gain authority over its own migration.

C-C requires the implementation's own visible test suite to include at least one deliberately contradictory skill/contract fixture that the check operation rejects, reviewed by the evaluator at verify time for genuineness (the fixture must actually exercise structural validation, not merely assert a trivial constant).

C-C requires the implementation's own visible test suite to demonstrate a bounded disposable exercise scenario against a candidate without granting it trusted workflow authority or publishing; the scenario's exact shape is implementation freedom bounded by frozen brief §9.

E5 asserts spike.md, design-map.md, and bootstrap/authority.md remain present and that authority.md still preserves the recorded bootstrap baseline commit and frozen evaluator/implementation content identities, guarding against deletion or silent rewrite during migration work.

M-A confirms the frozen design-map.md's own "Generic kernel handback to Spike 014a" table already durably records every KERNEL_SUPPORT_REQUIRED item; because design-map.md is frozen and not edited by the implementation, this is re-confirmed at verify time only via the mandatory content-identity check, not a separate hidden test.
